input: Find cooking and baking summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Asheville, NC (every part of the city: downtown, West, North, South and East Asheville). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville kids cooking baking summer camp 2026

candidates.name: Asheville Mountain Kitchen
candidates.note: Hands-on cooking and baking camps for ages 9–14; eight weeks offered in summer 2026.

candidates.name: The Asheville Kitchen
candidates.note: North Asheville youth baking camps, including cake decorating and desserts for ages 10–16, in summer 2026.

candidates.name: The Crunchy Baker
candidates.note: Co-teaches three 2026 sweet-and-savory baking and dessert camps at The Asheville Kitchen, 9am–12:30pm.

candidates.name: Lisa Smith Teaches
candidates.note: East Asheville Baking Adventures for ages 6–14 in June 2026; also offers filmmaking and animation camps.

candidates.name: The Educational Garden Project
candidates.note: 2026 garden camps combine cooking, gardening, animals and art; ages 6–10, with CIT opportunities for ages 11–16.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Buncombe County Center
candidates.note: 2026 4-H Summer Fun day camps include cooking and canning alongside agriculture, cultures and art.

candidates.name: Homemade Pasta Noodles
candidates.note: Kids cooking camp offered June 8–12, 2026, 10am–2pm, at its Maple Street shop.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Haywood County Center
candidates.note: 2026 Farm to Fork cooking camp for ages 10–14; also summer sewing, crafts, electricity and archery programs.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Burke County Center
candidates.note: June 2026 Burke Extension Youth Camp for ages 8–18 includes kitchen food-and-nutrition activities, farms and gardening.

candidates.name: Camp Merri-Mac
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight camp with cooking electives; 2026 campers made pasta, cookies and decorated cupcakes.

candidates.name: Camp Greystone
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight camp includes culinary and Cooking in the Garden activities, documented in its 2026 staff profiles.

candidates.name: East Tennessee State University
candidates.note: Renaissance Child summer camps for rising grades 1–6 include Kitchistry weeks with extended cooking activities.
